player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id}. Yin ee tɛn Battleship game.
Yin caarɛ ee tɛn wëërɛɛl kɛɛl kɛɛl ee yin opponent kuɛɛl kɛɛl ee yin.
Yin pɛɛnɛɛl, yin ee tɛn missiles kɛɛl kɛɛl ee coordinates kɛɛl kɛɛl ee format: '[a4]'. Yin ee missile kɛɛl kɛɛl ee ship, ee marked 'X'. Yin ee kɛɛl ee misses, ee marked 'O'. Yin ee scenario, game environment ee inform yin ee yin hits. Yin ee sunk boat, game environment ee tell yin!
Game ee tɛn ee yin player kuɛɛl kɛɛl ee sunk.
Yin initial board ee show yin ee ships kɛɛl kɛɛl ee yin opponent ee hits ee yin, ee yin hits ee misses ee yin opponent ee board ee kuɛɛl ee yin opponent ee ships.
Yin ee initial board:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kä ram min ŋar /cɛ jɛ luɔc kɛ gua̱th in ca mat thi̱n rɛy kiɛɛni̱ ti̱ cuŋ ɛ la i̱nɔ.
invalid_move.already_fired: Kä kɔrdi̱nɛt {coord} cɛ ku thuŋ cu ma̱a̱r.

game_action.you_sunk:
Cɔl kuɔt! Ya cɔl kuɔt at {coord}! Kuɔt cɔl ku wɛ̈iɛl:
{view}
game_action.opp_sunk:
Kɛɛr mi nhiam raan wa kɛɛri ɛ mwɛɛr {coord} ɛ ciɛ̈ɛ̈l! Lɔ̈k yɔ̈ɔ̈m de wɛ̈ɛ̈r:
{view}
game_action.you_hit:
Hit! Yin ee hit ship ee {coord}! Yin updated board:
{view}
game_action.opp_hit:
Kɔɔc ajiɛɛl rɛw mi wuɔɔ kɛ {coord}! Rɛw mi cɔk diɛɛt:
{view}
game_action.you_miss:
Kɛl! Yɛn kɛl tɛm dɛɛ {coord}! Tɛmdu yɛn:
{view}
game_action.opp_miss:
Kɛɛr mi nhiam raan wa kɛɛri ɛ mwɛɛr {coord}! Lɔ̈k yɔ̈ɔ̈m de wɛ̈ɛ̈r:
{view}

outcome.win: Ji̱ ŋarä {player_id} ci kɛn murkäbni̱ tin kɔakɛ diaal yuɔr piny!
